portable_cli_regression.interpretation: Per-controller means condition on that controller succeeding; matched-success means use identical successful seed pairs. Small same-asset tests are not universal reliability or hardware evidence.
portable_cli_regression.scope: same single door/handle, limited reset-pose distribution; not randomized door physics, force safety, or hardware acceptance
portable_cli_regression.perception: privileged simulated handle pose/axes; NOT visual closed-loop

scope: Four-episode portable CLI regression; not an additional held-out performance experiment. Original 32-pair evidence remains separate.
